description.value: Big Bad John's is a world-famous hillbilly bar that traces its roots to BC's first-ever licensed cocktail lounge, opened in 1954 at the Strathcona Hotel. Originally a temporary transformation for the 1962 Seattle World's Fair, the bar proved so popular with patrons that it never reverted — peanut shells still litter the floor and guests are invited to add their own mementos to the walls. It operates as one of several distinct venues within the large Strathcona Hotel entertainment complex in the heart of downtown Victoria.
